content.title: Trump Outlines Plan to Unwind Biden-Era Car Mileage Mandates
content.summary: “Today my administration is taking historic action to lower costs for American consumers, protect American auto jobs and make buying a car much more affordable for countless American families — and also safer,” Trump said in an Oval Office event Wednesday with representatives from Detroit’s major automakers.  Trump was joined by Stellantis NV Chief Executive Officer Antonio Filosa, Ford Motor Co. CEO Jim Farley and John Urbanic, plant manager at General Motors Co.’s Orion Assembly plant outside Detroit.

content.title: Ford, GM, Stellantis Stocks Rise. Thank President Trump.
content.summary: Shares of traditional auto makers rose on Wednesday, boosted by proposed policy changes that favor gasoline-powered cars over their all-electric peers.  Shares of Chrysler’s parent,  Stellantis  rose 4.5% to $11.46.  President Donald Trump spoke in the Oval Office, saying he has instructed Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy to rescind the “horrible CAFE standards,” which govern how efficient cars must be.

content.title: US auto sales: Ford EV demand slips while Kia sees monthly gain
content.description:
November's US auto sales are out, showing declines in Ford (F) and Hyundai's (005380.KS) vehicle sales year-over-year, while Kia's (000270.KS) sales climbed by 3%.

Cox Automotive Executive Analyst Erin Keating comes on Market Domination to discuss the demand trends surrounding EVs, SUVs, and large trucks.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
